content: Length, breadth and thickness of a strip having a uniform cross section are measured to be 10.5 cm, 0.05 mm, and 6.0 μm, respectively. Which of the following option(s) give(s) the volume of the strip in cm3 with correct significant figures:
explanation:
we know, lbh
